DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の予約ですね。通訳の方もご一緒に来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to book a consultation. Will an interpreter accompany you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を手伝ってくれる友人と来たいです。ただ、二人とも仕事があるので、予約してから友人に休みを取ってもらうつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳を頼む友人との相談予約に二人の勤務調整が必要だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to come with a friend who helps me with Japanese. But we both work, so I was planning to book first and then ask my friend to take time off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that booking a consultation with your interpreting friend requires coordinating both work schedules. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 来週の木曜なら、午後二時と四時が空いています。ご都合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Next Thursday we have two and four in the afternoon available. Would either suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は午後なら大丈夫です。友人は三時まで仕事なので、四時のほうを相談したいです。今、連絡してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの空き時間を受け友人の終業時刻に合う候補を選び連絡の時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Any afternoon time works for me. My friend works until three, so I would like to discuss four o'clock. May I contact them now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the available time fitting your friend's finishing time and ask for time to contact them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。お返事が来たら、空きをもう一度確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. When they reply, we will check availability again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四時なら仕事の後に来られると返事が来ました。休みを取らなくて済みそうです。四時をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の返信を報告し休暇不要で来られる四時の予約を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They replied that they can come after work if it is at four. It looks as though they will not need time off. Please book four o'clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report your friend's reply and request four o'clock, when no leave is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四時はまだ空いています。ご予約は、相談されるご本人のお名前でお取りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Four is still available. We will make the booking under the name of the person receiving the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前でお願いします。日時の連絡も私が受けて、友人に伝えます。通知を一緒に読んでもらって準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談本人の名義と本人への連絡を希望し通知を友人と読んで準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please use my name. I will also receive the date and time information and pass it to my friend. We will read the notice together and prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request booking and contact in your own name and explain that you will prepare by reading the notice with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご予約の内容をこちらに書きます。当日は、ご相談の通知もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will write the booking details here. Please also bring your consultation notice on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週木曜の四時ですね。二人で来ます。友人が訳してくれますが、私が自分で答えるときは少し待っていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時と同伴を確認し自分が答える際に待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next Thursday at four, then. We will both come. My friend will interpret, but when I answer myself, I would appreciate a little time to do so.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the date, time, and companion, and ask them to wait when you answer yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。ゆっくりお話を伺います。こちらの予約メモをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will listen at your pace. Please take this booking note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類を見て、気になるところがございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there anything that concerned you when you looked at the documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 領収書が二枚あるので、同じ日に二回払ったのかと思ってしまいました。何の分か説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書二枚を二重支払いと心配し内訳を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two receipts, so I thought I might have paid twice on the same day. Could you explain what each is for?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express concern that two receipts mean double payment and ask for the breakdown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの受診では、検査分と診察分の領収書が分かれています。金額は、お会計の合計に含めてお支払いいただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this visit, the examination and consultation receipts are separate. You paid both amounts as part of the total at checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の追加請求ではないんですね。今のカードの支払い記録と、二枚の合計を見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加請求ではないと理解しカード記録と合計を照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not a separate additional charge. I would like to compare the current card payment record with the total of the two receipts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is not an additional charge and request comparing the card record with the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが合計額です。カードのお控えもお持ちでしたら、そちらと照らし合わせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the total. If you have your card receipt too, you can compare it with that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えがありました。二枚を足すと同じ金額です。会社へ受診日の説明をするため、片方だけ残せばいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一致を報告し会社提出のため片方だけ残す考えだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found the card receipt. Adding the two gives the same amount. I had thought I only needed to keep one to explain the date of my visit to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that the amounts match and explain you had planned to keep only one for your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類はどちらもお手元に保管してください。会社が必要とするものは、提出先へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep both documents. Check with your company which documents they require you to submit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。二枚とも受診日は同じですが、検査と診察を分けたものだと説明できるよう、まとめて入れておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両領収書を保管し内訳が分かるようまとめる希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. Both show the same visit date, but I want to keep them together so I can explain that they separate the examination and consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will retain both receipts and keep them together with the breakdown clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、二枚をこの封筒へお入れします。カードのお控えも一緒にしまわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will put both in this envelope. Would you like to keep your card receipt with them too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。追加で払うものではないと分かったので、三枚を保管し、会社には必要な書類を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い済みと理解しカード控えも含め保管して提出条件を会社に聞くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. Now I understand they are not extra amounts to pay, I will keep all three and ask my company which documents are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge payment is complete and decide to keep the card receipt too and ask your company about submission requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封筒にお入れしました。こちらをお持ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: They are in the envelope. Please take this. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布についてのご連絡を受けて、お越しになったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come after receiving our message about the wallet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。茶色の財布が届いたと電話がありました。私のものなら受け取りたいですが、同じ色の財布は多いと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 候補財布の連絡で来訪したが色だけで自分の物と断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I received a call saying a brown wallet had been handed in. I would like to collect it if it is mine, but many wallets are the same color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came about a possible wallet but will not identify it as yours by color alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の届け出の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the copy of your earlier lost-property report?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。外からは見えにくいんですが、内側の角に白い糸で縫い直した所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遺失届控えを提示し内側の修理した糸を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It is hard to see from outside, but an inside corner has been restitched with white thread.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the lost-property report copy and describe the repaired stitching inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その特徴も照合します。届け出の時には、修理した部分のお話はありませんでしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will compare that feature too. You did not mention the repaired part when reporting it, did you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話を受けてから思い出しました。古い写真も見つけましたが、修理前なので糸の部分は写っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目印を後から思い出し写真は修理前と補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I remembered after the call. I also found an old photo, but it was taken before the repair, so it does not show the thread.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you remembered the feature later and the photo predates the repair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真は修理前として拝見します。中に入っていたカードなどについても伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will view the photo as showing it before repair. May I also ask about cards and other things that were inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前のある図書館カードがあります。番号は覚えていませんが、名前の表記はこの身分証と同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前のある図書館カードと本人資料の表記一致を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a library card with my name. I do not remember the number, but the spelling of the name is the same as on this identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the named library card and the matching name on your identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。外側の色だけでなく、修理箇所とカードの情報も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will check the repair and card information as well as the outside color.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、控えと身分証を出します。写真は修理前だと分かる形で見ていただき、私の財布か照合してから受取りを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えと本人資料で候補を照合してから受取相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will provide the report copy and identification. Please view the photo with it clear that it is from before the repair; I will discuss collection after you compare it to confirm whether the wallet is mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to compare the possible wallet using your report and identification before discussing collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらへどうぞ。お預かりした情報と候補の財布を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come this way. We will compare the information provided with the possible wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票のお荷物について、どんなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about the parcel on your missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜の再配達を申し込んだんですが、急に仕事が延びて、指定した時間に家へ帰れなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達申込み後の勤務延長で指定時間に在宅できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I requested redelivery tonight, but work has unexpectedly run late and I cannot get home at the specified time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that extended work after requesting redelivery prevents you being home at the specified time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込みの番号はお分かりですか。今夜の配達が進んでいるか、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the request number? I will check with the person responsible whether tonight's delivery is already underway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号はこちらです。明日の朝から出張なので、別の日へ変えるより、窓口で受け取れるかを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号を示し出張前に窓口受取へ変更できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the number. I leave on a business trip tomorrow morning, so rather than changing it to another day, I would like to discuss whether I can collect it at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the number and ask about changing to counter collection before your business trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口で受け取れる状態かも担当の確認が必要です。今こちらに荷物があるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also need the person responsible to check whether it is ready for counter collection. I cannot promise the parcel is here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今ここで受け取れると思って来てしまいました。配達中なら、家へ行ってもらわないよう変更の相談を先にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口在庫を思い込んでいたと認め今夜の扱い変更を先に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came assuming I could collect it here now. If it is out for delivery, please first ask about changing the arrangements so they do not go to my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge assuming the parcel was at the counter and first request changing tonight's arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ連絡します。ご本人宛てのお荷物ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will contact the person responsible. The parcel is addressed to you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この宛名が私です。必要な本人確認書類も持っています。出張は三日間なので、その間の保管も含めて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人宛てと資料を示し出張三日間の保管も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, this addressee is me. I have the necessary identification too. My business trip lasts three days, so I would also like to ask about storage during that period.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you are the addressee, show identification, and ask about storage for the three-day trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今夜の扱い、窓口受取りの可否と、保管についてまとめて照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will inquire together about tonight's arrangements, whether counter collection is possible, and storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今夜家にいないことと、明日から三日間出張することを伝えて、可能な受取り方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不在予定をまとめて伝え担当照会後に受取方法を選ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Please explain that I will not be home tonight and will be away on business for three days from tomorrow. I would like to choose a collection method that is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize your absence and decide to choose collection after the staff inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へ連絡します。不在票と本人確認書類をお手元に、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will contact the person responsible with those details. Please wait here with your missed-delivery notice and identification ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳をお持ちですね。本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a passbook. What can we help you with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妻の給料が入ったか確認したいんです。妻は仕事なので、私が通帳を預かって来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妻の勤務中に通帳を持参して給与の入金確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to check whether my wife's salary has come in. She is at work, so I brought her passbook for her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Bring your wife's passbook while she works and request checking her salary deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥様の口座ですね。通帳をお持ちでも、ご本人の取引内容をこの場でお伝えすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is your wife's account. Even with her passbook, we cannot tell you her transaction details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族なら聞けると思っていました。妻から頼まれたメッセージもありますが、それだけでは確認できないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族でも本人の取引を聞けず依頼メッセージだけでは足りないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought family could ask. I have a message from my wife asking me to do this, but that alone is not enough to check, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that family cannot obtain her transaction details and her request message alone is insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。奥様ご本人からご相談いただく必要があります。お困りなのは、入金額の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is right. Your wife herself needs to consult us. Is the difficulty checking the deposit amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。でも妻は日本語で電話するのが不安だそうです。私が隣で言葉を手伝う形なら、相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妻の電話の不安を伝え本人のそばで言語支援する相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. But she says she is worried about making a call in Japanese. Could she consult you with me beside her helping with the language?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your wife's concern about calling and ask how she can consult with language support beside her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言葉のお手伝いはできます。本人確認の際は、奥様ご自身にお答えいただきます。相談方法の案内をお渡ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may help with the language. During identity verification, your wife must answer herself. Shall I give you information on how to consult us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。妻が電話する前に、必要な物と受付時間をこの紙で一緒に確認します。私が代わりに答えるのは控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内を求め妻本人が確認事項に答えられるよう受付時間と必要物を準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Before my wife calls, we will use this sheet to check the required items and service hours together. I will refrain from answering for her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request guidance and say you will prepare the hours and required items so your wife can answer verification herself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの案内です。詳しい手続きが必要な場合は、電話でその方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the information. If a detailed procedure is needed, we will explain how to do it by phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、今日は通帳を持ち帰ります。妻に本人から相談する必要があると伝えて、私は言葉の手伝いをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳を持ち帰り妻本人から相談して自分は言語支援をすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the passbook home today, then. I will tell my wife she needs to consult you herself and help her with the language.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the passbook home, have your wife consult herself, and provide language help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通帳と案内をお返しします。奥様からのお問い合わせをお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here are the passbook and information. We look forward to your wife's inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日の商品についてのご相談ですね。どんな状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss yesterday's product. What condition is it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買ったジャムのふたが空回りして閉まりません。瓶を持つと漏れそうだったので、今日は写真とレシートだけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉まらないジャム瓶を漏れ懸念で持参せず写真とレシートだけ提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lid on the jam I bought spins without closing. It looked as if it might leak when carried, so today I only brought photos and the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show only photos and receipt because you did not bring the unclosable jam jar for fear of leakage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。開封した後の状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the photos. Is this its condition after opening?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、初めて開けた後です。瓶の縁に欠けがあるかは、写真ではよく分かりません。無理に締めるのはやめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初開封後の状態と欠け不明で無理に締めていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, after opening it for the first time. I cannot tell clearly from the photos whether the jar's rim is chipped. I stopped trying to force it shut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is after first opening, chipping is unclear, and you have not forced it closed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対応を判断するには、担当が現物の状態を確認する必要があります。写真だけで交換のお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: To decide how to respond, the person responsible needs to inspect the actual item. We cannot promise an exchange from photos alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。現物を持ってくる間にこぼれないよう、別の容器へ移してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物確認を理解し持参前の移し替え可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. May I transfer the contents to another container so it does not spill while I bring it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the actual item must be inspected and ask about transferring its contents before bringing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入した状態が分かるよう、移し替える前に担当へ相談してください。持参時の包み方も担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult the person responsible before transferring it, so its purchased condition can be established. They will also explain how to wrap it for transport.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、中身は移さず、ふたが閉まらない状態だと担当へ伝えてください。今日はその相談の連絡先を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移し替えず状態を担当へ伝え連絡先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not transfer it. Please tell them the lid will not close. Today I would like the contact details for that consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not transfer it, have the condition relayed, and request contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが商品相談の連絡先です。レシートの商品名と購入日をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the product inquiry contact details. Please provide the product name and purchase date from the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入日と商品名をメモします。現物をどう持参するか先に相談し、写真だけで交換が決まったとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入情報を控え持参方法を先に聞いてから現物相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the purchase date and product name. I will first ask how to bring the actual item and avoid assuming the exchange was approved from photos alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note purchase information and decide to ask about transport before consulting with the actual item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。レシートをお返しします。持参方法について、担当へお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is your receipt back. Please contact the person responsible about how to bring it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かございましたか。お連れの方をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened? Are you looking for someone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが見当たりません。ここで休んでいたら、少し先の遊具へ行ったと思ったんですが、今は見えないんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩中に子どもを見失ったと場所と行動を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find my child. While we were resting here, I thought they went to the playground a little ahead, but I cannot see them now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where you were and what happened when you lost sight of your child while resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遊具の方へ行ったかは、まだ分からないのですね。最後に姿を見た場所と、お子さんの年齢、服装を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You do not yet know whether they went toward the playground, then. Please tell me where you last saw them, their age, and their clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後に見たのは、このベンチの横です。六歳で、黄色い帽子と青い上着です。見えなくなって二分くらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもの年齢服装と見えなくなった時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I last saw them beside this bench. They are six, wearing a yellow hat and blue jacket. It has been about two minutes since I lost sight of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the child's age, clothes, and how long they have been out of sight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの係員にも伝えます。保護者の方は、今こちらを離れずにいていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the other staff too. Could you, as the guardian, stay here for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分も走って探そうとしていましたが、ここにいます。子どもの名前も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 独力の捜索を止め現在地に残り名前を伝えると応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I was about to run and look myself, but I will stay here. I will also tell you my child's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to stop searching alone, stay where you are, and provide the name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前をお願いします。顔の分かる最近の写真はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me the name. Do you have a recent photo showing their face?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前はミンです。今朝の写真があります。ここでは上着を着たので、写真の服とは違いますが、顔は分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前と今朝の顔写真を出し現在の上着が写真と違うと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name is Minh. I have a photo from this morning. They put on a jacket here, so the clothes differ from the photo, but the face is clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide the name and this morning's face photo, noting that the current jacket differs from the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。こちらの職員が遊具の周りから確認しますので、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me see it. Our staff will start by checking around the playground, so please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真をお見せします。黄色い帽子と青い上着のミンを探していると伝えてください。私はこのベンチの所で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の特徴を職員へ伝えてもらい最後のベンチで待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show you the photo. Please tell them we are looking for Minh in a yellow hat and blue jacket. I will wait by this bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have current identifying features relayed to staff and decide to wait at the last bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 特徴と最後の場所を共有しました。私もここにいますので、何か思い出したらすぐにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have shared the identifying features and last location. I will stay here too; please tell me immediately if you remember anything else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符のご相談ですね。どちらまでご乗車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about tickets. How far will you travel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は列車には乗りません。母が旅行するので、荷物を持ってホームまで見送りたいんですが、どの切符が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は乗車せず母の荷物をホームまで運んで見送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will not be taking a train. My mother is traveling, and I would like to carry her luggage to the platform and see her off. What ticket do I need?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not travel, but want to carry your mother's luggage to the platform and see her off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見送りで改札内へ入る場合は、入場券についてご案内します。お母様の乗車券はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: For entering the ticket gates to see someone off, we will explain platform admission tickets. Does your mother have her travel ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母はもう持っています。二人分の乗車券を買わなくてよいんですね。私は入場するための分だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母の乗車券はあり自分は入場のみの切符を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: She already does. So I do not need to buy travel tickets for both of us. Please give me just the ticket for my admission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your mother has her travel ticket and request only admission for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。入場券では列車に乗れません。利用時間などは、この案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. You cannot ride a train with an admission ticket. Please see this information for the permitted duration and other conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母の出発まで三十分ほどです。案内を見てから買います。大きい荷物があるので、ホームへはエレベーターを使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発までの時間を伝え入場条件を読み荷物のためエレベーターを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is about thirty minutes until my mother's departure. I will read the information before buying. She has large luggage, so I would like to use the lift to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time until departure, read admission conditions, and request the lift because of luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: エレベーターはこちらです。お見送りの後は、こちらの出口へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The lift is this way. After seeing her off, you can return to this exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母が乗るときは荷物を渡して、私はホームから見送ります。帰りも同じエレベーターで戻っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分は列車に入らず見送り同じ経路で出口へ戻れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: When my mother boards, I will hand her the luggage and see her off from the platform. May I use the same lift on the way back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stay on the platform and ask whether the same route leads back to the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。同じ経路で改札へ戻れます。切符は出口までお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You can return to the gates along the same route. Please keep your ticket until the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、案内の条件を確かめて入場券を一枚買います。荷物をホームまで運んだら母を見送り、同じ道で戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後に自分の入場券一枚を買い見送り後に戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will check the conditions and buy one admission ticket. After carrying the luggage to the platform, I will see my mother off and return the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to buy one admission ticket after checking conditions and return after seeing your mother off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入場券一枚ですね。購入方法はこちらです。お母様の乗車券と分けてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: One admission ticket, then. Here is how to buy it. Please keep it separate from your mother's travel ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知について、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss the notice you brought, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 追加の書類を出すように書いてあります。金曜日が期限ですが、会社に頼んだ書類が来週になると言われて困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の期限に勤務先資料の取寄せが間に合わないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to submit additional documents. The deadline is Friday, but my company says the document I requested will not be ready until next week, so I am worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the workplace document will not be obtained by the deadline in the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不足している書類は、どの項目でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この勤務先に関する書類です。ほかはそろっていますが、会社の書類だけは自分で作れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不足項目を示しほかはそろうが会社資料は自分で作れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This document about my employer. I have everything else, but I cannot make the company's document myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the missing item, explain other documents are ready, but you cannot create the employer document yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ期限の相談を取り次ぎます。会社から受取り予定日を聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will refer your deadline question to the person responsible. Has your company told you when you will receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週の月曜です。会社からその予定をメールでもらっています。必要なら、画面をお見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料の受取予定日と会社のメールがあることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Next Monday. The company emailed me that schedule. I can show you the screen if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the scheduled receipt date and that you have an email from your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拝見します。担当に期限と提出方法を確認しますので、今そろっている書類も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me see. I will check the deadline and submission method with the person responsible. Could you also show the documents already ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。不足している一枚以外はそろっています。今日出しておいて、会社の書類だけ後から持ってくることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今ある書類を提示し先行提出と不足分の後日提出を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here they are. Everything except that one missing sheet is ready. Could I submit these today and bring only the company document later?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show current documents and ask about submitting them now and the missing one later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に確認できました。こちらは今日受け付け、不足分は月曜にお持ちください。受付の控えに、追加する書類と提出日を記載します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have confirmed with the person responsible. We will accept these today; bring the missing item on Monday. We will write the additional document and submission date on your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら助かります。今日はこの分を提出して、会社の書類は月曜に持ってきます。控えの書類名と日付も確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可された提出方法に同意し不足分の提出日と書類名を受付控えで確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: That would help. I will submit these today and bring the company document on Monday. Please also let me check the document name and date on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to the permitted submission method and request checking the missing document name and date on the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが控えです。追加の書類はこちらに記載しています。受取り予定が変わった場合は、この連絡先へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your receipt. The additional document is written here. If the expected receipt date changes, please let us know at this contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。お名前の読み方を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Please let me confirm how to pronounce your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前はグエン・ヴァン・ミンです。受付で名字だけ呼ばれると、自分のことか分からないことがあるんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名を伝え名字だけでは自分の呼出しか分かりにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is Nguyễn Văn Minh. When reception calls only the family name, sometimes I cannot tell whether they mean me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your full name and explain that calls using only your surname are hard to identify. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カタカナの読み方を記録します。こちらの表記でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will record the pronunciation in katakana. Is this spelling correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この表記で合っています。会社ではミンと呼ばれているので、呼出しのときに名前まで言ってもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カタカナ表記を確認し普段の呼び名を含めた呼出しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This spelling is correct. At work people call me Minh, so it would help if you included my given name when calling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm katakana spelling and request calls including the name you usually use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望を伝えます。診察の呼出しには受付番号の表示もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass on your request. There is also a reception-number display for consultation calls.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号でも確認できるんですね。私の番号は二十七番で合っていますか。名前が聞き取れなかったら、この票を見せて聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付番号を確認し呼出しが聞き取れなければ票を見せて聞いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I can check by number too. Is my number twenty-seven? If I cannot catch the name, may I show this slip and ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your reception number and ask whether you can show the slip if you cannot hear the call clearly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ご不安でしたら、票を持って職員へお尋ねください。お待ちになる場所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If unsure, take the slip and ask a staff member. Please wait over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。少しトイレへ行きたいんですが、今、席を離れても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今トイレへ行くため席を離れてよいか許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I would like to go to the toilet briefly. Is it all right to leave my seat now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission to leave your seat for the toilet now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大丈夫です。お戻りになったら受付へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. Please tell reception when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先にトイレへ行って、戻ったら受付に声を掛けます。その後、二十七番の票を持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰席時に受付へ知らせその後は番号票を持って待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will use the toilet first and tell reception when I return. Afterward I will wait with my number twenty-seven slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will notify reception on returning and then wait with the number slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 読み方とご希望を記録しました。順番まで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have recorded the pronunciation and your request. Please wait here until your turn.
